calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

generation: Retain all original input frames, raw projection/typed IO, support and accuracy gates. Detect at most 900 Shi-Tomasi candidates with original quality/distance/margin. Admit at most the first 300 with all nine 3x3 raw depth counts in [500,25000] and 50*maximum_deviation <= max(5000,median_count); replace only owned selected source-depth samples by their integer median. Use the original 0.75px LK/2px PnP/20-track/15-inlier/0.5-fraction gates. Promote the previous accepted frame at age 30 or when fewer than 60 geometric-inlier tracks survive; preserve the world chain, all failures and no recovery resets. Source input files are never filtered or modified.
scope: Previously observed development data. Separate native-only refit-policy revision, fixed before candidate generation. Existing failed and complete baseline results retained; no held-out, calibrated Autoware, changed thresholds or general motion claim.

acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.

native_refinement_policy: Preserve the selected deterministic RANSAC hypothesis when optional final inlier refitting errors or worsens the same inlier-count/inlier-error objective. Sampling, thresholds, refinement initialization, frontend and geometric admission remain unchanged.
